atoms.text: 74–76% browser/runtime maturity must not be treated as final product completion.
Completion reporting uses four axes: function implementation, UI structure definition, UI-function integration, user-facing product maturity.
UI work follows product purpose → IA → screen contract → component contract → owner/state/event mapping → visual system → implementation → E2E.
Do not jump from mockup directly to CSS without contract mapping.
Every visible control maps to owner, source of truth, state, event, transition, validation and failure state.
Every critical existing capability must have a UI destination or explicit intentional-hidden disposition.
390x844 is primary mobile design reference for browser UI work.
Character visuals use runtime slots/hooks and are not hard-coded into core layout.
Ready owns planning/execution/scheduling/confirmation/results; Snap & Pop and Hide & Seek domain logic remains outside Ready.
Provisional user-facing maturity before final UI integration should be treated conservatively around 45–55%.
Static screenshots alone cannot establish UI completion; runtime integration and regression evidence are required.
